annotations.title: Webhook alerts on funding gaps and costs (Pro, 29 USDC)

description: PAID: 29 USDC on Base per 30 days on up to 3 pairs (status and cancel are free), via x402 (no account; an x402-enabled client pays automatically). A POST to your webhook the minute a rule starts to hold, checked every minute on the live books: a delta-neutral funding gap netting at least your threshold after opening and closing both legs, or a venue whose round-trip cost at your size drops to your threshold. Signed with HMAC-SHA256. We test your webhook first: if it does not answer, you are not charged.

rules.description: subscribe: rules, on up to 3 pairs

max_cost_bps.description: trading_cost: some venue round-trips at or below this

min_net_usd.description: funding_gap: best couple nets at least this

pair.description: Base asset of the perpetual, e.g. BTC

secret.description: status/cancel: the secret given at subscribe

webhook_url.description: https URL that receives the POSTs (subscribe)
